title: Page 12
transc:
Ft Monroe Feb 5 1864 
H Snow Yorktown
Wistar I rec'd from general sedgwick
following telegram period <insertion>quotation</insertion> a dispatch from
label directs such Cooper ration with
you as I can give I
will be ready to do so
on Sun day the seventh instant
by vigor us demon stray shuns
in my front unless the weather
should render it impossible period <insertion>quotation</insertion> period
I am about sending the following
reply period <insertion>quotation</insertion> Can you not make
it tomorrow with out regard to
weather I hope to strike the
point sun day morning at six
oclock period <insertion>quotation</insertion> Is that right or
shall he move sund day My
reply to him awaits your answer
sign Butler Hurry this up quick
Geo D Sheldon
